subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
14. AMC Travels is running 4 luxury buses between two cities which are 60 kms.
apart. The seating capacity of each bus is 50 passengers. The actual
passengers carried were 70% of the seating capacity. All the four buses run
for 30 days for the month. Each bus made one round trip per day. During the
month of April 2026, AMC incurred total cost of ` 25,05,000.

What is the cost per passenger kilometer for the month of April 2026?
(A)  ` 7.55
(B)  ` 3.75
(C)  ` 6.84
(D)  ` 4.97
(2 Marks)

COST AND MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTING

7
